bio: Under the guidance of multi-starred chef Nino Di Costanzo, a fine dining destination takes shape along one of Italy’s most celebrated gourmet streets, set within the elegant spaces of an international hotel showcasing its most exclusive brand. The atmosphere exudes refined contemporary flair: soft lighting, minimalist décor, and works by local artists that engage with the space. At the table, Neapolitan identity is expressed through dishes bearing dialect names, dressed in a modern aesthetic: creations that evoke tradition yet come alive with contemporary details, in a harmony of colors and textures. The service, attentive and professional, discreetly guides an experience that bridges heritage and innovation, weaving together authentic flavors and signature inspirations....
